description: Reader-rule vectors (docs/VERSIONING.md). For each case, a reader at version `reader` given the raw parsed `document`, before decode, must return `outcome`: missing|malformed|incompatible|newer|upgradable|current. Rows are checked first-match in that table order; only `schema_version` of the document is inspected. Error rows carry `expected_message`, the exact text the reader must raise.
